اغترفنا (form VIII)
# اِغْتَرَفْنَا (iḡtarafnā) /iɣ.ta.raf.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِغْتَرَفَ (iḡtarafa)
# اُغْتُرِفْنَا (uḡturifnā) /uɣ.tu.rif.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِغْتَرَفَ (iḡtarafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
